# platform-binpath-baseline — hardcoded platform-divergent command-binary
# path literals (/usr/sbin/chown, /usr/sbin/lsof, and any absolute
# openclaw CLI path) per file under packages/admin/evolve_admin.
# Generated by `tools/platform-path-lint --rule binpath --all
# --update-baseline`. These binaries live at a different absolute path
# per platform, and the daemon's sudo NOPASSWD grants are rendered with
# the platform-correct binary — so a hardcoded path makes sudo prompt
# (no TTY) and the op fails silently. Route chown/lsof through
# platform_profile.get_profile().chown / .lsof, and openclaw through
# platform_profile.find_openclaw_cli() (resolved at call time). The lint
# blocks any file that EXCEEDS its count, so this file may only ratchet
# DOWN. Goal state: empty.
